title: Hex Tag
description: Tag on a hex grid. Both players secretly commit a move and a prediction of where the opponent will end up.

title: Flow Fighter
description: Pick a card, reveal together, climb the ladder. First to the trophy wins.

title: Delivery Van
description: Plan your route, deliver the parcels. Play solo, live or async.

title: Votes
description: Build districts, bring in families, win the seats when cities merge. For 2–5 players.

title: Kowloon
description: Stack polycube towers in 3D without blocking anyone's windows. Sandbox for 2–5 players.

title: Game Template
description: The starting point for two-player lab games where both choose at the same time. Its example game is rock-paper-scissors.

title: Turn-Based Game Template
description: The starting point for lab games where 2–5 players take turns in order. Its example game is Pig, a push-your-luck dice game.
